heading: Thursday Night
text: Chance of evening showers near and south of Route 4, except likely near the Massachusetts border; otherwise becoming mostly clear. Areas of valley fog. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s, with some mid 40s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Friday
text: Morning valley fog burning off, then mostly sunny and pleasant. Highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s. North to northeast winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Friday Night
text: Mostly clear early, then come clouds late, mainly south. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s. Winds becoming light, variable to northeast.
